note: Resynthesis for issue #172: the ISRAM_1RW single-port I-SRAM option (decision record 0006) is removed. The option had no macro view -- soc_fabric raised $error on any ISRAM_1RW=1 + SOC_SRAM_MACRO build -- so it never reached P&R, STA or signoff. With the option gone every subordinate grant into obi_xbar is constant 1'b1, so obi_xbar's five *_gnt_i ports are deleted too; i_gnt_o is constant and d_gnt_o keeps its real arbitration term (!i_to_rom, boot-ROM fetch priority unchanged). The default build's logic is unchanged: the deleted logic was already constant in the ISRAM_1RW=0 elaboration. synth_result.json is this commit's klt output; synth_result_baseline.json is the unmodified-main run's, kept so the before figures are auditable rather than asserted. The baseline netlist reproduced main's committed one byte-for-byte (sha256 0c5cd5ba...), so the after-delta is this change, not the toolchain. Both runs used TMPDIR unset -- klt synthesize deadlocks in Yosys' abc pass on this host under the loom sandbox TMPDIR (filed at 2AMLogic/klayout-tools); every committed netlist was produced that way.
